topic: Renting a Storage Unit for the Summer

script.title: UNIT TWELVE, PLEASE
script.scene_zh: 倉儲中心櫃台 · 估位簽約
script.story_hook: One apartment's furniture needs a summer hotel.
script.intro_zh: 一整戶人家的家具，需要一間過夏天的旅店。
script.welcome_en: Hi, today we rent a storage unit. Listen for sizes, fees, and fine print.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，今天要去租一個倉位。留意空間大小、費用與合約細節的說法。
script.outro: Every box found a summer home today. Listen again and pocket the phrases.
script.outro_zh: 每個紙箱今天都有了夏日小家。再聽一遍，把這些說法放進口袋。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat each line before the gate closes.
script.practice_intro_zh: 在倉庫大門關掉之前，我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: Nobody has promised my fridge that
script.char_a_description: a friendly man in his early sixties with a full white beard, a balding head under a navy baseball cap, an orange fishing vest over a denim shirt, reading glasses on a cord, and a broad build
script.char_b_description: a young woman in her early twenties with black hair in two long braids streaked pink, an oversized brown corduroy jacket, bright green sneakers, round wire glasses, and a tall slim build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I need to store a whole apartment's worth.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ nid tə stɔːr ə hoʊl əˈpɑɹtmənz wɜɹθ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我得把整戶人家的東西都存起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you! How long are we talking?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs tə miːt ju haʊ lɔːŋ ɑːɹ wi ˈtɔːkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 認識你很高興！要存多久呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, two months, just for the summer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm tu mʌnθs dʒʌst fɚ ðə ˈsʌmɚ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，兩個月，就整個夏天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easy. What all is going into storage?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizi wʌt ɔl ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ ˈɪntə ˈstɔːrɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 容易。都是哪些東西要進倉呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Couch, recliner, fridge, boxes, lamps, my chess table.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊtʃ ɹɪˈklaɪnɚ fɹɪdʒ ˈbɑksəz læmps maɪ tʃɛs ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 沙發、躺椅、冰箱、紙箱、檯燈，還有我的棋桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Whoa, the recliner too? Okay, let's size you.
dialogue.phonetic: /woʊ ðə ɹɪˈklaɪnɚ tu oʊkeɪ lɛts saɪz ju/
dialogue.zh: 哇，躺椅也要？好，我們來估大小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Size me? Like shoes now?
dialogue.phonetic: /saɪz mi laɪk ʃuz naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 估大小？是像買鞋子那樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, like guessing the unit, ten by ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ laɪk ˈɡɛsɪŋ ði ˈjunɪt tɛn baɪ tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 哈，對，猜一個倉位，十呎見方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten by ten, that's a small house to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn baɪ tɛn ðæts ə smɔl haʊs tə mi/
dialogue.zh: 十呎見方，對我來說像一間小房子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's one tenth of a big house, but close.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts wʌn tɛnθ əv ə bɪɡ haʊs bʌt kloʊz/
dialogue.zh: 是大房子的十分之一啦，不過確實像。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take your math, you work here.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl teɪk jɔːɹ mæθ ju wɜːrk hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 你在這上班，你的數學我信得過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First-time customer, you're doing great.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚst taɪm ˈkʌstəməɚ jʊɹ ˈduɪŋ ɡɹeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 第一次租倉位已經很棒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One worry: the fridge, will it survive?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈwɜːɹi ðə fɹɪdʒ wɪl ɪt sɚˈvaɪv/
dialogue.zh: 有個擔心：冰箱，它撐得過來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Empty, dry, door propped open, it'll thrive.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛmpti dɹaɪ dɔːɹ pɹɑpt ˈoʊpən ɪtəl θɹaɪv/
dialogue.zh: 清空、擦乾、門撐開，它會活得很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thrive! Nobody has promised my fridge that.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɹaɪv ˈnoʊˌbɑdi hæz ˈpɹɑməst maɪ fɹɪdʒ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 活得很好！沒人跟我的冰箱保證過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, we should check climate control for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl wi ʃʊd tʃɛk ˈklaɪmɪt kənˈtɹoʊl fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我們該幫你查一下恆溫倉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Climate? Is that air-conditioning for boxes?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklaɪmɪt ɪz ðæt ˈɛɹ kənˈdɪʃənɪŋ fɚ ˈbɑksəz/
dialogue.zh: 恆溫？那是在幫紙箱吹冷氣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Basically, it keeps wood and electronics calm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbeɪsɪkli ɪt kiːps wʊd ænd ɪˌlɛkˈtɹɑnɪks kɑm/
dialogue.zh: 差不多，它讓木頭和電器都安定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My chess table is a very sensitive wood.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ tʃɛs ˈteɪbəl ɪz ə ˈvɛɹi ˈsɛnsəɾɪv wʊd/
dialogue.zh: 我的棋桌是很敏感的木頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then yes, climate unit, fifteen dollars extra.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn jɛs ˈklaɪmɪt ˈjunɪt ˌfɪfˈtin ˈdɑːləɹz ˈɛkstɹə/
dialogue.zh: 那就選恆溫倉，多加十五塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifteen... for a sensitive table, worth it.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪfˈtin fɚ ə ˈsɛnsəɾɪv ˈteɪbəl wɜːɹθ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 十五塊……為了敏感的棋桌，值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, the boring part, gate hours.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə ˈbɔːɹɪŋ pɑːɹt ɡeɪt ˈaʊɚz/
dialogue.zh: 接下來是無聊的部分，大門時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Boring is fine, tell me slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɔːɹɪŋ ɪz faɪn tɛl mi ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 無聊沒關係，慢慢說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six a.m. to ten p.m., every day.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks eɪ ˈɛm tə tɛn pi ˈɛm ˈɛvɹi deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 早上六點到晚上十點，天天都開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh good, I rise early and sleep early.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡʊd aɪ ɹaɪz ˈɜːɹli ænd slip ˈɜːɹli/
dialogue.zh: 很好，我起得早，睡得也早。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect fit. Insurance, do you have any?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜːɹfɪkt fɪt ɪnˈʃʊɹəns du ju hæv ˈɛni/
dialogue.zh: 剛好合適。保險，你有嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Insurance? For boxes? Um, explain that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈʃʊɹəns fɚ ˈbɑksəz ʌm ɪkˈspleɪn ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 保險？給紙箱保險？嗯，請解釋一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Renters policy covers it, about forty a month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɛntɚz ˈpɑləsi ˈkʌvɚz ɪt əˈbaʊt ˈfɔːɹti ə mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 租客保險就涵蓋，一個月約四十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have one! My son set it up in March.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv wʌn maɪ sʌn sɛt ɪt ʌp ɪn mɑːɹtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 我有！我兒子三月份弄好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then bring the card, we scan it here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn brɪŋ ðə kɑːɹd wi skæn ɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 那帶保單來，我們在這裡掃描。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scan it, sure. The lock, do you sell those?
dialogue.phonetic: /skæn ɪt ʃʊɹ ðə lɑk du ju sɛl ðoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 掃描，好。鎖呢，你們賣那種嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, cylinder lock, seven bucks, very tough.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈsɪləndɚ lɑk ˈsɛvən bʌks ˈvɛɹi tʌf/
dialogue.zh: 賣，圓筒鎖，七塊，非常結實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tough enough for a guy who forgets keys?
dialogue.phonetic: /tʌf ɪˈnʌf fɚ ə ɡaɪ huː fɚˈɡɛts kiz/
dialogue.zh: 結實到適合愛忘鑰匙的人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No lock remembers for you, friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ lɑk ɹɪˈmɛmbɚz fɚ ju fɹɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 再好的鎖也幫你記不住，朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair, I'll wear the key on a string then.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ aɪl wɛɹ ðə ki ɑn ə stɹɪŋ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 也對，那我就把鑰匙吊在繩子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old-school, I respect that. Month to month?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld skuːl aɪ ɹɪˈspɛkt ðæt mʌnθ tə mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 很有年代感，我欣賞。按月租嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, that's not standard? I assumed six months.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ðæts nɑt ˈstændɚd aɪ əˈsuːmd sɪks mʌnθs/
dialogue.zh: 等等，按月租不是常規嗎？我以為要簽六個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six-month deals exist, but nothing's required here.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks mʌnθ diːlz ɪɡˈzɪst bʌt ˈnʌθɪŋz ɹɪˈkwaɪəɹd hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 六個月的約也有，但沒人強迫你簽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Relief. I'm terrible at promising two years.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹɪˈlif aɪm ˈtɜːɹəbl æt ˈpɹɑməsɪŋ tu jɪɹz/
dialogue.zh: 鬆口氣。我最不擅長承諾兩年。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Month to month, cancel any time, honest.
dialogue.phonetic: /mʌnθ tə mʌnθ ˈkænsəl ˈɛni taɪm ˈɑːnɪst/
dialogue.zh: 按月租，隨時可退，說實話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any fee for leaving early in the month?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni fi fɚ ˈlivɪŋ ˈɜːɹli ɪn ðə mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 月中退掉，還有額外費用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we charge the first, you're free after.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ wi tʃɑːɹdʒ ðə fɚst jʊɹ fri ˈæftɚ/
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我們每月一號收費，之後你隨時退都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal. Now the price, hit me gently.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil naʊ ðə pɹaɪs hɪt mi ˈdʒɛntli/
dialogue.zh: 成交。現在說價格，請溫柔點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ninety with climate, plus insurance, plus lock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪnti wɪð ˈklaɪmɪt plʌs ɪnˈʃʊɹəns plʌs lɑk/
dialogue.zh: 含恆溫九十，再加保險和鎖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's fairer than my son's phone bill.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈfɛɹɚ ðæn maɪ sʌnz foʊn bɪl/
dialogue.zh: 這比我兒子的手機帳單公道多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, that's the American benchmark right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðæts ði əˈmɛɹɪkən ˈbɛntʃˌmɑːɹk ɹaɪt ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，這就是美國物價的標竿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where's my unit? The one near the door?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛɹz maɪ ˈjunɪt ði wʌn nɪɹ ðə dɔːɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我的倉位在哪？靠近大門那個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Number twelve, close, but on the truck aisle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌmbɚ twɛlv kloʊz bʌt ɑn ðə tɹʌk ˈaɪsəl/
dialogue.zh: 十二號，很近，在卡車通道邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My daughter can back the van in, easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈdɔːtɚ kæn bæk ðə væn ɪn ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 我家丫頭會把車倒進位，輕鬆得很。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, vans fit fine, the aisle is wide.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt væns fɪt faɪn ði ˈaɪsəl ɪz waɪd/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，廂型車停得下，通道很寬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, she drives, I just carry the boxes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ʃi dɹaɪv aɪ dʒʌst ˈkæɹi ðə ˈbɑksəz/
dialogue.zh: 好在有她開車，我只負責搬紙箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the plan. Here, sign on the tablet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə plæn hɪɹ saɪn ɑn ðə ˈtæblət/
dialogue.zh: 就這樣說定。來，在平板上簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tablet! In my day, this was a clipboard.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtæblət ɪn maɪ deɪ ðɪs wəz ə ˈklɪpˌbɔːɹd/
dialogue.zh: 平板！我那個年代，這要用書寫夾板。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clipboards retired with the fax machine, sir.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklɪpˌbɔːɹdz ɹɪˈtaɪɹd wɪð ðə fæks məˈʃin sɚ/
dialogue.zh: 書寫夾板跟傳真機一起退休了，先生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't remind me, the fax haunted us all.
dialogue.phonetic: /doʊnt ɹɪˈmaɪnd mi ðə fæks ˈhɔːntəd ʌs ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 別提醒我，傳真機陰了我們一輩子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's resting now. Two taps and you're done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈɹɛstɪŋ naʊ tu tæps ænd jʊɹ dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 它已安息了。點兩下，你就辦好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done! Gate code, lock, card, what's next?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ɡeɪt koʊd lɑk kɑːɹd wʌts nɛkst/
dialogue.zh: 辦好！大門密碼、鎖、保單，下一步？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Visit once, meet your boxes, then summer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɪzɪt wʌns mit jɔːɹ ˈbɑksəz ðɛn ˈsʌmɚ/
dialogue.zh: 先去認一次門，跟你的紙箱打個照面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My chess table says thank you, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ tʃɛs ˈteɪbəl sɛz ˈθæŋk ju ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 我的棋桌說謝謝你，真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say hi to the recliner, unit twelve, see you.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ haɪ tə ðə ɹɪˈklaɪnɚ ˈjunɪt twɛlv si ju/
dialogue.zh: 也跟躺椅說聲嗨，十二號見囉。

script.youtube_title: 【夏日租倉位📦】「沒人跟我的冰箱保證過」估大小談保險🔑🎧｜月租・大門時間・合約細節｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Renting a Storage Unit
script.youtube_title_en: "Nobody Has Promised My Fridge That" — Renting a Storage Unit for the Summer
script.youtube_description:
「沒人跟我的冰箱保證過」——夏天暫住別處，一整戶家具要用英文租個倉位存放，會聊些什麼？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在倉儲中心的櫃台。

你會聽到：開場說明需求的說法；靠對話估倉位大小，十呎見方到底多大；恆溫倉是什麼、要多花多少；大門時間、保險證明、買鎖與按月租約的完整細節；還有中途退租怎麼算錢的問法。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人辦櫃台業務的真實語感：um、well、ha、whoa。聽完你就會用：how long are we talking、month to month、gate hours、back the van in。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先記住，腦袋自然就跟上。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Nobody has promised my fridge that" — what does it sound like to rent a storage unit for the summer in real English? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice at the counter of a storage center.

You will hear: opening the request, sizing a unit through conversation, what climate control is and what it adds, gate hours, proof of insurance, buying a cylinder lock, month-to-month terms, and the honest question of leaving early in the month.

Everything stays in A2-level words with real counter texture: um, well, ha, whoa. By the end you'll own phrases like How long are we talking, month to month, and back the van in.

The final chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
夏天的兩個月裡，家裡的東西要暫時搬開存放，那沙發、躺椅、冰箱和一整堆紙箱要去哪過夏？倉位大小怎麼估、恆溫要不要加錢、保險證明怎麼弄，用英文怎麼問？

這一集帶大家走進倉儲中心的櫃台，聽一位白鬍子老先生跟年輕的倉管小姐從估倉位一路聊到簽平板，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
📦 估倉位：Ha, like guessing the unit, ten by ten.
🧊 問冰箱：One worry: the fridge, will it survive?
🌡️ 問恆溫：Climate? Is that air-conditioning for boxes?
📄 問月租：Wait, that's not standard? I assumed six months.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、ha 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這一趟櫃台對話走完，下次你要租任何東西，大小、費用、細節都問得出來。

祝你所有的紙箱，都過一個安穩的夏天。
